# Work plan

Order tasks by dependency. Every task should have a visible outcome and a way to verify it. Keep this board small and link to detailed plans when needed.

## Milestone 1: Setup
- [ ] [Task] — acceptance: [observable result]

## Milestone 2: Core behavior
- [ ] [RED] Add a focused failing test for [behavior].
- [ ] [GREEN] Implement [behavior] to pass the test.
- [ ] [REFACTOR] Simplify while keeping checks green.

## Milestone 3: Integration
- [ ] [Task] — depends on: [task]; acceptance: [observable result]

## Milestone 4: Delivery
- [ ] Verify acceptance criteria with [commands].
- [ ] Record limitations and follow-up work.
